_comment: #219: a settings document written before the twenty fields nothing read
were removed. Read by BOTH sides:
- src-tauri/src/settings/mod.rs (unit), src-tauri/tests/ipc_roundtrip_tests.rs
and src-tauri/tests/backup_tests.rs load it through the real struct, the
real database row and a real export;
- tests/unit/control/settings-retired-keys.test.ts serves it to the real
settings service.
`get_settings` falls back to `AppSettings::default()` when a document does
not parse, so a mistake here resets EVERY setting, calibrated rigs included,
without a word. Each side therefore asserts that this document reads exactly
as the same document with `retired` deleted, and every surviving value a
person can choose is moved off its default (and, on the frontend, off what
the one-time overlay adoptions would rebuild — the panel mirror sets
`vertical`, which the old global switch never could), so the comparison
cannot be two copies of the defaults. The recogniser has one possible value.
Several retired values are ones the old validator REFUSED (a 5000 ms
debounce, a 40 px editor font, a 9x wheel, an unknown fidelity mode): a
leftover range check would turn a stale key into a document that cannot be
saved, which is the failure #217 had to guard against for `saveTranscript`.
`retired` lists every removed path. `editor` is the whole section.
